messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT - p99 latency spike detected for service=redwood-inference-frontend region=eu-west. threshold=p99>1200ms. autopager triggered. pagerduty:incident_id=PD-3421

pagerduty: PagerDuty incident PD-3421 fired (severity: high) — @maria (oncall) notified

maria (oncall): acked. I'm on it, pulling traces now.

kevin (infra): thx. I'm checking autoscaler and instance health. any sign of hotkeys?

zane (runtime): seeing a small spike in kv-cache evictions + GPU queue depth rising on pool=dedicated-eu-2. Could be batching backlog.

maria (oncall): notes: traffic up ~2.3x last 5m from a few customers. p95 ~420ms, p99 ~1.6s. Customer-impact: some interactive customers will see slow responses.

sre-jen: heads-up to CS if we need to send a note.

kevin (infra): running: kubectl get hpa -n inference frontend-hpa -o yaml then scaling rc. command: `kubectl patch deployment frontend --patch '{"spec":{"replicas":8}}'`

zane (runtime): trying warmup: triggering kv cache warm for top 100 prefixes, and temporarily switching routing policy to prefer low-batch, low-latency hosts.

maria (oncall): executing runbook step: promote fallback model variant `ggml-medium-latency` for customer tier=platinum. Will keep routing to lower-cost models off.

incident-bot: Autopager action: increased capacity request to dedicated-eu-2 by +2 GPUs. Request id=cap-req-8811

kevin (infra): autoscaler accepted nodes, new nodes coming up. ETA ~70s. watching node readiness.

zane (runtime): applied routing override. Also temporarily disabled large-batch tuning in the sidecar to reduce tail latency.

maria (oncall): can folks watch p99 and top-end latency traces? I'll update PD and timeline.

kevin (infra): nodes Ready. redispatcher reports queue depth dropping 40%.

zane (runtime): p99 decreased to ~980ms at 1745011360. p95 back to ~310ms. Looks like backlog draining.

maria (oncall): good. leaving routing override in place for 15m, then we roll back if stable. placing note: "rollback in 15m"

pagerduty: PD-3421 annotated: acknowledgment by maria at 1745011152.

maria (oncall): quick customer-impact summary for CS: brief latency spike affecting small subset of requests in eu-west between 1745011080-1745011320. Mitigated by adding capacity and routing override. No errors, just higher tail latency.

sre-jen: thanks — I'll draft a short bulletin if CS wants to proactively message top affected customers.

kevin (infra): marking autoscaler logs: `scale_up reason=queue_depth, delta_nodes=2, time=1745011225`, no infra errors.

zane (runtime): follow-up: we'll run a post-incident check for batching heuristics; suspect a sudden traffic fanout combined with an unevicted KV hotkey.

maria (oncall): setting follow-up ticket: OPS-1157 "Investigate eu-west p99 spike: batching heuristics + KV hotkey". Assigning to zane + kevin.

incident-bot: Autopager resolved: PD-3421 status=acknowledged -> monitoring.

maria (oncall): leaving a final note: system stable, p99 ~250-400ms, will monitor for 30m. If no recurrence, we close after RCA doc.

kevin (infra): +1. good job.

zane (runtime): I'll start the KV/telemetry capture for RCA.

maria (oncall): closing thread soon. thanks everyone :thumbsup:

pagerduty: PD-3421 status updated: monitored -> resolved (pending RCA)
